repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The IR specifies a one-shot wait followed by a cycle. The candidate incorrectly executes the cycle body (valve close and email send) in the 'else' branch, causing the valve to close and email to be sent again at t=60000ms when the condition is false. The IR only repeats the email send every minute after the initial sequence; it never repeats the valve close.
diagnosis.change_summary: Removed the duplicate actions from the 'else' branch. The 'else' branch must be empty to stop the script after the initial cycle body completes, matching the IR's `until: null` (infinite cycle) which only re-arms the email send, not the initial valve close.
